verses.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν
verses.transliteration: Iēsous de eporeuthē eis to oros tōn elaiōn
verses.literal: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives
verses.literalPt: JESUS, porém, foi para o Monte das Oliveiras.

verses.original: Ὄρθρου δὲ πάλιν παρεγένετο εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ καθίσας ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Orthrou de palin paregeneto eis to hieron kai pas ho laos ērcheto pros auton kai kathisas edidasken autous
verses.literal: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts All the people came to Him and He sat down to teach them
verses.literalPt: E pela manhã cedo tornou para o templo, e todo o povo vinha ter com ele, e, assentando-se, os ensinava.

verses.original: ἄγουσιν δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς αὐτὸν γυναῖκα ἐπὶ μοιχείᾳ κατειλημμένην καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ
verses.transliteration: agousin de hoi grammateis kai hoi Pharisaioi pros auton gynaika epi moicheia kateilēmmenēn kai stēsantes autēn en mesō
verses.literal: The scribes and Pharisees however brought to Him a woman caught in adultery They made her stand . . . before them . . .
verses.literalPt: E os escribas e fariseus trouxeram-lhe uma mulher apanhada em adultério;

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατείληπται ἐπ’ αυτοφώρῳ μοιχευομένη
verses.transliteration: legousin autō Didaskale hautē hē gynē kateilēptai ep’ autophōrō moicheuomenē
verses.literal: and said Teacher this woman was caught in the act of adultery
verses.literalPt: E, pondo-a no meio, disseram-lhe: Mestre, esta mulher foi apanhada, no próprio ato, adulterando.

verses.original: ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσῆς ἡμῖν ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθάζειν σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις
verses.transliteration: en de tō nomō Mōusēs hēmin eneteilato tas toiautas lithazein sy oun ti legeis
verses.literal: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman So what do You say
verses.literalPt: E na lei nos mandou Moisés que as tais sejam apedrejadas. Tu, pois, que dizes?

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγον πειράζοντες αὐτόν ἵνα ἔχωσιν κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας τῷ δακτύλῳ κατέγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Touto de elegon peirazontes auton hina echōsin katēgorein autou ho de Iēsous katō kypsas tō daktylō kategraphen eis tēn gēn
verses.literal: They said this to test Him in order to have a basis for accusing Him But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger
verses.literalPt: Isto diziam eles, tentando-o, para que tivessem de que o acusar. Mas Jesus, inclinando-se, escrevia com o dedo na terra.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν ἀνέκυψεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν πρῶτος τὸν λίθον ἐπ’ αὐτῇ βαλέτω
verses.transliteration: Hōs de epemenon erōtōntes auton anekypsen kai eipen autois Ho anamartētos hymōn prōtos ton lithon ep’ autē baletō
verses.literal: When they continued to question Him He straightened up and said to them Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her
verses.literalPt: E, como insistissem, perguntando-lhe, endireitou-se, e disse-lhes: Aquele que de entre vós está sem pecado seja o primeiro que atire pedra contra ela.

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν κάτω¦κύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: kai palin katō¦kypsas egraphen eis tēn gēn
verses.literal: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground
verses.literalPt: E, tornando a inclinar-se, escrevia na terra.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθ‿ εἷς ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἕως τῶν ἐσχάτων καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ οὖσα
verses.transliteration: Hoi de akousantes exērchonto heis kath heis arxamenoi apo tōn presbyterōn heōs tōn eschatōn kai kateleiphthē monos ho Iēsous kai hē gynē en mesō ousa
verses.literal: When they heard this they began to go away one by one beginning with the older ones until . . . . . . - only Jesus was left with the woman standing there
verses.literalPt: Quando ouviram isto, redargüidos da consciência, saíram um a um, a começar pelos mais velhos até aos últimos; ficou só Jesus e a mulher que estava no meio.

verses.original: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῇ Ἡ Γύναι ποῦ εἰσιν ἐκεῖνοι οἱ κατήγοροί σου οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν
verses.transliteration: anakypsas de ho Iēsous eipen autē HĒ Gynai pou eisin ekeinoi hoi katēgoroi sou oudeis se katekrinen
verses.literal: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her Woman where are your accusers Has no one condemned you
verses.literalPt: E, endireitando-se Jesus, e não vendo ninguém mais do que a mulher, disse-lhe: Mulher, onde estão aqueles teus acusadores? Ninguém te condenou?

verses.original: Ἡ δὲ εἶπεν Οὐδείς κύριε Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐδὲ ἐγώ σε κατακρίνω πορεύου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε
verses.transliteration: Hē de eipen Oudeis kyrie Eipen de autē ho Iēsous Oude egō se katakrinō poreuou kai apo tou nyn mēketi hamartane
verses.literal: No one Lord - she answered Then neither do I condemn you - Jesus declared Now . . . . . . go and sin no more
verses.literalPt: E ela disse: Ninguém, Senhor. E disse-lhe Jesus: Nem eu também te condeno; vai-te, e não peques mais.

verses.original: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου ὁ ἀκολουθῶν ἐμοὶ οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἀλλ’ ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: Palin oun autois elalēsen ho Iēsous legōn Egō eimi to phōs tou kosmou ho akolouthōn emoi ou mē peripatēsē en tē skotia all’ hexei to phōs tēs zōēs
verses.literal: Once again . . . Jesus spoke to the people and said I am the light of the world Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness but will have the light of life
verses.literalPt: Falou-lhes, pois, Jesus outra vez, dizendo: Eu sou a luz do mundo; quem me segue não andará em trevas, mas terá a luz da vida.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι Σὺ περὶ σεαυτοῦ μαρτυρεῖς ἡ μαρτυρία σου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun autō hoi Pharisaioi Sy peri seautou martyreis hē martyria sou ouk estin alēthēs
verses.literal: So the Pharisees said to Him You are testifying about Yourself Your testimony is not valid
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os fariseus: Tu testificas de ti mesmo; o teu testemunho não é verdadeiro.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Κἂν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία μου ὅτι οἶδα πόθεν ἦλθον καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἔρχομαι ἢ ποῦ ὑπάγω
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois Kan egō martyrō peri emautou alēthēs estin hē martyria mou hoti oida pothen ēlthon kai pou hypagō hymeis de ouk oidate pothen erchomai ē pou hypagō
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . Even if I testify about Myself My testimony is valid because I know where I came from and where I am going But you do not know where I came from or where I am going
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Ainda que eu testifico de mim mesmo, o meu testemunho é verdadeiro, porque sei de onde vim, e para onde vou; mas vós não sabeis de onde venho, nem para onde vou.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κρίνετε ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω οὐδένα
verses.transliteration: Hymeis kata tēn sarka krinete egō ou krinō oudena
verses.literal: You judge according to the flesh I judge no one
verses.literalPt: Vós julgais segundo a carne; eu a ninguém julgo.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν κρίνω δὲ ἐγώ ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ ἀληθινή ἐστιν ὅτι μόνος οὐκ εἰμί ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ
verses.transliteration: kai ean krinō de egō hē krisis hē emē alēthinē estin hoti monos ouk eimi all’ egō kai ho pempsas me patēr
verses.literal: But even if I do judge My judgment is true because I am not alone I am with the Father who sent Me
verses.literalPt: E, se na verdade julgo, o meu juízo é verdadeiro, porque não sou eu só, mas eu e o Pai que me enviou.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ δὲ τῷ ὑμετέρῳ γέγραπται ὅτι δύο ἀνθρώπων ἡ μαρτυρία ἀληθής ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Kai en tō nomō de tō hymeterō gegraptai hoti dyo anthrōpōn hē martyria alēthēs estin
verses.literal: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid
verses.literalPt: E na vossa lei está também escrito que o testemunho de dois homens é verdadeiro.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὁ πέμψας με Πατήρ
verses.transliteration: egō eimi ho martyrōn peri emautou kai martyrei peri emou ho pempsas me Patēr
verses.literal: I am One who testifies about Myself and the Father who sent Me also testifies about Me
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o que testifico de mim mesmo, e de mim testifica também o Pai que me enviou.

verses.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ Πατήρ σου Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Οὔτε ἐμὲ οἴδατε οὔτε τὸν Πατέρα μου εἰ ἐμὲ ᾔδειτε καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε
verses.transliteration: Elegon oun autō Pou estin ho Patēr sou Apekrithē Iēsous Oute eme oidate oute ton Patera mou ei eme ēdeite kai ton Patera mou an ēdeite
verses.literal: Where is Your Father they asked Him You do not know . . . Me or My Father Jesus answered If you knew Me you would know My Father as well
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Onde está teu Pai? Jesus respondeu: Não me conheceis a mim, nem a meu Pai; se vós me conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai.

verses.original: Ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπίασεν αὐτόν ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tauta ta rhēmata elalēsen en tō gazophylakiō didaskōn en tō hierō kai oudeis epiasen auton hoti oupō elēlythei hē hōra autou
verses.literal: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the treasury Yet no one seized Him because His hour had not yet come
verses.literalPt: Estas palavras disse Jesus no lugar do tesouro, ensinando no templo, e ninguém o prendeu, porque ainda não era chegada a sua hora.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς Ἐγὼ ὑπάγω καὶ ζητήσετέ με καὶ ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὑμῶν ἀποθανεῖσθε ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun palin autois Egō hypagō kai zētēsete me kai en tē hamartia hymōn apothaneisthe hopou egō hypagō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein
verses.literal: Again He said to them I am going away and you will look for Me but you will die in your sin Where I am going you cannot come
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus outra vez: Eu retiro-me, e buscar-me-eis, e morrereis no vosso pecado. Para onde eu vou, não podeis vós vir.

verses.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Μήτι ἀποκτενεῖ ἑαυτὸν ὅτι λέγει Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: Elegon oun hoi Ioudaioi Mēti apoktenei heauton hoti legei Hopou egō hypagō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein
verses.literal: So the Jews began to ask Will He kill Himself since He says Where I am going you cannot come
verses.literalPt: Diziam, pois, os judeus: Porventura quererá matar-se a si mesmo, pois diz: Para onde eu vou não podeis vir?

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί ὑμεῖς ἐκ τούτου τοῦ κόσμου ἐστέ ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois Hymeis ek tōn katō este egō ek tōn anō eimi hymeis ek toutou tou kosmou este egō ouk eimi ek tou kosmou toutou
verses.literal: Then He told them You are from below I am from above You are of this world I am not of this world
verses.literalPt: E dizia-lhes: Vós sois de baixo, eu sou de cima; vós sois deste mundo, eu não sou deste mundo.

verses.original: εἶπον οὖν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ πιστεύσητε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: eipon oun hymin hoti apothaneisthe en tais hamartiais hymōn ean gar mē pisteusēte hoti egō eimi apothaneisthe en tais hamartiais hymōn
verses.literal: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins For unless . . . you believe that I am He you will die in your sins
verses.literalPt: Por isso vos disse que morrereis em vossos pecados, porque se não crerdes que eu sou, morrereis em vossos pecados.

verses.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ Σὺ τίς εἶ Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τὴν ἀρχὴν ὅ¦τι καὶ λαλῶ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Elegon oun autō Sy tis ei Eipen autois ho Iēsous Tēn archēn ho¦ti kai lalō hymin
verses.literal: Who are You they asked Just what I have been telling you from the beginning Jesus replied . . .
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Quem és tu? Jesus lhes disse: Isso mesmo que já desde o princípio vos disse.

verses.original: πολλὰ ἔχω περὶ ὑμῶν λαλεῖν καὶ κρίνειν ἀλλ’ ὁ πέμψας με ἀληθής ἐστιν κἀγὼ ἃ ἤκουσα παρ’ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα λαλῶ εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: polla echō peri hymōn lalein kai krinein all’ ho pempsas me alēthēs estin kagō ha ēkousa par’ autou tauta lalō eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: I have much to say about you and much to judge But the One who sent Me is truthful and what I have heard from Him I tell . . . the world
verses.literalPt: Muito tenho que dizer e julgar de vós, mas aquele que me enviou é verdadeiro; e o que dele tenho ouvido, isso falo ao mundo.

verses.original: Οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι τὸν Πατέρα αὐτοῖς ἔλεγεν
verses.transliteration: Ouk egnōsan hoti ton Patera autois elegen
verses.literal: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father
verses.literalPt: Mas não entenderam que ele lhes falava do Pai.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὅταν ὑψώσητε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τότε γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ποιῶ οὐδέν ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἐδίδαξέν με ὁ Πατὴρ ταῦτα λαλῶ
verses.transliteration: eipen oun autois ho Iēsous Hotan hypsōsēte ton Huion tou anthrōpou tote gnōsesthe hoti egō eimi kai ap’ emautou poiō ouden alla kathōs edidaxen me ho Patēr tauta lalō
verses.literal: So Jesus said When you have lifted up the Son of Man then you will know that I am He and that I do nothing on My own but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Quando levantardes o Filho do homem, então conhecereis quem eu sou, e que nada faço por mim mesmo; mas falo como meu Pai me ensinou.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν οὐκ ἀφῆκέν με μόνον ὅτι ἐγὼ τὰ ἀρεστὰ αὐτῷ ποιῶ πάντοτε
verses.transliteration: kai ho pempsas me met’ emou estin ouk aphēken me monon hoti egō ta aresta autō poiō pantote
verses.literal: He who sent Me is with Me He has not left Me alone because I always do what pleases Him
verses.literalPt: E aquele que me enviou está comigo. O Pai não me tem deixado só, porque eu faço sempre o que lhe agrada.

verses.original: Ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Tauta autou lalountos polloi episteusan eis auton
verses.literal: As Jesus spoke these things many believed in Him
verses.literalPt: Dizendo ele estas coisas, muitos creram nele.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς πεπιστευκότας αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίους Ἐὰν ὑμεῖς μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῷ ἐμῷ ἀληθῶς μαθηταί μού ἐστε
verses.transliteration: Elegen oun ho Iēsous pros tous pepisteukotas autō Ioudaious Ean hymeis meinēte en tō logō tō emō alēthōs mathētai mou este
verses.literal: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him If you continue in My word you are truly My disciples
verses.literalPt: Jesus dizia, pois, aos judeus que criam nele: Se vós permanecerdes na minha palavra, verdadeiramente sereis meus discípulos;

verses.original: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai gnōsesthe tēn alētheian kai hē alētheia eleutherōsei hymas
verses.literal: Then you will know the truth and the truth will set you free . . .
verses.literalPt: E conhecereis a verdade, e a verdade vos libertará.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν πρὸς αὐτόν Σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐσμεν καὶ οὐδενὶ δεδουλεύκαμεν πώποτε πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι Ἐλεύθεροι γενήσεσθε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan pros auton Sperma Abraam esmen kai oudeni dedouleukamen pōpote pōs sy legeis hoti Eleutheroi genēsesthe
verses.literal: We are Abraham’s descendants they answered . . . . . . We have never been slaves . . . to anyone How can You say we will be set free
verses.literalPt: Responderam-lhe: Somos descendência de Abraão, e nunca servimos a ninguém; como dizes tu: Sereis livres?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν δοῦλός ἐστιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois ho Iēsous Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti pas ho poiōn tēn hamartian doulos estin tēs hamartias
verses.literal: Jesus replied Truly truly I tell you everyone who sins is a slave to sin
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que todo aquele que comete pecado é servo do pecado.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ δοῦλος οὐ μένει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὁ υἱὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: ho de doulos ou menei en tē oikia eis ton aiōna ho huios menei eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: A slave does not remain in the house forever but a son remains forever
verses.literalPt: Ora o servo não fica para sempre em casa; o Filho fica para sempre.

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν ὁ Υἱὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλευθερώσῃ ὄντως ἐλεύθεροι ἔσεσθε
verses.transliteration: ean oun ho Huios hymas eleutherōsē ontōs eleutheroi esesthe
verses.literal: So if the Son sets you free you will be free indeed
verses.literalPt: Se, pois, o Filho vos libertar, verdadeiramente sereis livres.

verses.original: Οἶδα ὅτι σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐστε ἀλλὰ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Oida hoti sperma Abraam este alla zēteite me apokteinai hoti ho logos ho emos ou chōrei en hymin
verses.literal: I know you are Abraham’s descendants but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you
verses.literalPt: Bem sei que sois descendência de Abraão; contudo, procurais matar-me, porque a minha palavra não entra em vós.

verses.original: ἃ ἐγὼ ἑώρακα παρὰ τῷ Πατρὶ λαλῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ἃ ἠκούσατε παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ποιεῖτε
verses.transliteration: ha egō heōraka para tō Patri lalō kai hymeis oun ha ēkousate para tou patros poieite
verses.literal: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of the Father and you do what you have heard from your father
verses.literalPt: Eu falo do que vi junto de meu Pai, e vós fazeis o que também vistes junto de vosso pai.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ τέκνα τοῦ Ἀβραάμ ἐστε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ἐποιεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan kai eipan autō Ho patēr hēmōn Abraam estin Legei autois ho Iēsous Ei tekna tou Abraam este ta erga tou Abraam epoieite
verses.literal: Abraham is our father they replied . . . . . . . . . If you were children of Abraham said . . . Jesus you would do the works of Abraham
verses.literalPt: Responderam, e disseram-lhe: Nosso pai é Abraão. Jesus disse-lhes: Se fôsseis filhos de Abraão, faríeis as obras de Abraão.

verses.original: νῦν δὲ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι ἄνθρωπον ὃς τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὑμῖν λελάληκα ἣν ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦτο Ἀβραὰμ οὐκ ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: nyn de zēteite me apokteinai anthrōpon hos tēn alētheian hymin lelalēka hēn ēkousa para tou Theou touto Abraam ouk epoiēsen
verses.literal: But now you are trying to kill Me a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God Abraham never did such a thing
verses.literalPt: Mas agora procurais matar-me, a mim, homem que vos tem dito a verdade que de Deus tem ouvido; Abraão não fez isto.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν Εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ Ἡμεῖς ἐκ πορνείας οὐ γεγεννήμεθα ἕνα Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: hymeis poieite ta erga tou patros hymōn Eipan oun autō Hēmeis ek porneias ou gegennēmetha hena Patera echomen ton Theon
verses.literal: You are doing the works of your father We are not illegitimate children . . . . . . they declared . . . Our only Father is God Himself
verses.literalPt: Vós fazeis as obras de vosso pai. Disseram-lhe, pois: Nós não somos nascidos de prostituição; temos um Pai, que é Deus.

verses.original: Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ ὁ Θεὸς Πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἦν ἠγαπᾶτε ἂν ἐμέ ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἥκω οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ἐλήλυθα ἀλλ’ ἐκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν
verses.transliteration: Eipen autois ho Iēsous Ei ho Theos Patēr hymōn ēn ēgapate an eme egō gar ek tou Theou exēlthon kai hēkō oude gar ap’ emautou elēlytha all’ ekeinos me apesteilen
verses.literal: Jesus said to them If God were your Father you would love Me for I have come here from God - I have not come . . . on My own but He sent Me
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Se Deus fosse o vosso Pai, certamente me amaríeis, pois que eu saí, e vim de Deus; não vim de mim mesmo, mas ele me enviou.

verses.original: Διὰ τί τὴν λαλιὰν τὴν ἐμὴν οὐ γινώσκετε ὅτι οὐ δύνασθε ἀκούειν τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐμόν
verses.transliteration: Dia ti tēn lalian tēn emēn ou ginōskete hoti ou dynasthe akouein ton logon ton emon
verses.literal: Why . . . do you not understand what I am saying It is because you are unable to accept My message
verses.literalPt: Por que não entendeis a minha linguagem? Por não poderdes ouvir a minha palavra.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ οὐκ ἔστηκεν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hymeis ek tou patros tou diabolou este kai tas epithymias tou patros hymōn thelete poiein ekeinos anthrōpoktonos ēn ap’ archēs kai en tē alētheia ouk estēken hoti ouk estin alētheia en autō hotan lalē to pseudos ek tōn idiōn lalei hoti pseustēs estin kai ho patēr autou
verses.literal: You belong to . . . your father the devil and you want to carry out his desires He was a murderer from the beginning refusing to uphold the truth because there is no truth in him When he lies . . . . . . he speaks his native language because he is a liar and the father of lies
verses.literalPt: Vós tendes por pai ao diabo, e quereis satisfazer os desejos de vosso pai. Ele foi homicida desde o princípio, e não se firmou na verdade, porque não há verdade nele. Quando ele profere mentira, fala do que lhe é próprio, porque é mentiroso, e pai da mentira.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ὅτι τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: egō de hoti tēn alētheian legō ou pisteuete moi
verses.literal: But because I speak the truth you do not believe Me
verses.literalPt: Mas, porque vos digo a verdade, não me credes.

verses.original: Τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐλέγχει με περὶ ἁμαρτίας εἰ ἀλήθειαν λέγω διὰ τί ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: Tis ex hymōn elenchei me peri hamartias ei alētheian legō dia ti hymeis ou pisteuete moi
verses.literal: Which of you can prove Me guilty . . . of sin If I speak the truth why . . . do you not believe Me
verses.literalPt: Quem dentre vós me convence de pecado? E se vos digo a verdade, por que não credes?

verses.original: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀκούει διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἀκούετε ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἐστέ
verses.transliteration: ho ōn ek tou Theou ta rhēmata tou Theou akouei dia touto hymeis ouk akouete hoti ek tou Theou ouk este
verses.literal: Whoever belongs to . . . God hears the words of God The reason . . . you do not hear is that you do not belong to God
verses.literalPt: Quem é de Deus escuta as palavras de Deus; por isso vós não as escutais, porque não sois de Deus.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Οὐ καλῶς λέγομεν ἡμεῖς ὅτι Σαμαρίτης εἶ σὺ καὶ δαιμόνιον ἔχεις
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan hoi Ioudaioi kai eipan autō Ou kalōs legomen hēmeis hoti Samaritēs ei sy kai daimonion echeis
verses.literal: The Jews answered . . . . . . Him Are we not . . . right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon
verses.literalPt: Responderam, pois, os judeus, e disseram-lhe: Não dizemos nós bem que és samaritano, e que tens demônio?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἐγὼ δαιμόνιον οὐκ ἔχω ἀλλὰ τιμῶ τὸν Πατέρα μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀτιμάζετέ με
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous Egō daimonion ouk echō alla timō ton Patera mou kai hymeis atimazete me
verses.literal: I do not have a demon Jesus replied but I honor My Father and you dishonor Me
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu: Eu não tenho demônio, antes honro a meu Pai, e vós me desonrais.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ ζητῶ τὴν δόξαν μου ἔστιν ὁ ζητῶν καὶ κρίνων
verses.transliteration: egō de ou zētō tēn doxan mou estin ho zētōn kai krinōn
verses.literal: I do not seek My own glory There is One who seeks it and He is the Judge
verses.literalPt: Eu não busco a minha glória; há quem a busque, e julgue.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐάν τις τὸν ἐμὸν λόγον τηρήσῃ θάνατον οὐ μὴ θεωρήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō hymin ean tis ton emon logon tērēsē thanaton ou mē theōrēsē eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you if anyone keeps My word he will never see . . . . . . . . . death
verses.literalPt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que, se alguém guardar a minha palavra, nunca verá a morte.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Νῦν ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι δαιμόνιον ἔχεις Ἀβραὰμ ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται καὶ σὺ λέγεις Ἐάν τις τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσῃ οὐ μὴ γεύσηται θανάτου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun autō hoi Ioudaioi Nyn egnōkamen hoti daimonion echeis Abraam apethanen kai hoi prophētai kai sy legeis Ean tis ton logon mou tērēsē ou mē geusētai thanatou eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: Now we know that You have a demon declared the Jews Abraham died and so did the prophets yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste . . . . . . . . . death
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Agora conhecemos que tens demônio. Morreu Abraão e os profetas; e tu dizes: Se alguém guardar a minha palavra, nunca provará a morte.

verses.original: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ὅστις ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἀπέθανον τίνα σεαυτὸν ποιεῖς
verses.transliteration: mē sy meizōn ei tou patros hēmōn Abraam hostis apethanen kai hoi prophētai apethanon tina seauton poieis
verses.literal: Are You greater than our father Abraham He died as did the prophets Who do You claim to be . . .
verses.literalPt: És tu maior do que o nosso pai Abraão, que morreu? E também os profetas morreram. Quem te fazes tu ser?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἐὰν ἐγὼ δοξάσω ἐμαυτόν ἡ δόξα μου οὐδέν ἐστιν ἔστιν ὁ Πατήρ μου ὁ δοξάζων με ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous Ean egō doxasō emauton hē doxa mou ouden estin estin ho Patēr mou ho doxazōn me hon hymeis legete hoti Theos hēmōn estin
verses.literal: Jesus answered If I glorify Myself My glory means nothing The One who glorifies Me is My Father of whom you say He is our God
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu: Se eu me glorifico a mim mesmo, a minha glória não é nada; quem me glorifica é meu Pai, o qual dizeis que é vosso Deus.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώκατε αὐτόν ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα αὐτόν κἂν εἴπω ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν ἔσομαι ὅμοιος ὑμῖν ψεύστης ἀλλὰ οἶδα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τηρῶ
verses.transliteration: kai ouk egnōkate auton egō de oida auton kan eipō hoti ouk oida auton esomai homoios hymin pseustēs alla oida auton kai ton logon autou tērō
verses.literal: You do not know Him but I know Him If I said I did not know Him I would be a liar like you But I do know Him and I keep His word
verses.literalPt: E vós não o conheceis, mas eu conheço-o. E, se disser que o não conheço, serei mentiroso como vós; mas conheço-o e guardo a sua palavra.

verses.original: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἠγαλλιάσατο ἵνα ἴδῃ τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐμήν καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐχάρη
verses.transliteration: Abraam ho patēr hymōn ēgalliasato hina idē tēn hēmeran tēn emēn kai eiden kai echarē
verses.literal: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day He saw it and was glad
verses.literalPt: Abraão, vosso pai, exultou por ver o meu dia, e viu-o, e alegrou-se.

verses.original: Εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν Πεντήκοντα ἔτη οὔπω ἔχεις καὶ Ἀβραὰμ ἑώρακας
verses.transliteration: Eipon oun hoi Ioudaioi pros auton Pentēkonta etē oupō echeis kai Abraam heōrakas
verses.literal: Then the Jews said to Him You are not yet fifty years old and You have seen Abraham
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Ainda não tens cinqüenta anos, e viste Abraão?

verses.original: Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι ἐγὼ εἰμί
verses.transliteration: Eipen autois Iēsous Amēn amēn legō hymin prin Abraam genesthai egō eimi
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you Jesus declared . . . before Abraham was born I am
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que antes que Abraão existisse, eu sou.

verses.original: Ἦραν οὖν λίθους ἵνα βάλωσιν ἐπ’ αὐτόν Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐκρύβη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ
verses.transliteration: Ēran oun lithous hina balōsin ep’ auton Iēsous de ekrybē kai exēlthen ek tou hierou
verses.literal: At this they picked up stones to throw at Him But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area
verses.literalPt: Então pegaram em pedras para lhe atirarem; mas Jesus ocultou-se, e saiu do templo, passando pelo meio deles, e assim se retirou.
